srList.sentence: Protein analysis by immunostaining For immunofluorescent staining, 5-6 mm thick cryosections were fixed in cold 100 methanol for about 20 minutes, blocked with 10 horse serum, incubated with primary antibodies against Ki-67 (MA5-14520, Thermo Fisher Scientific), CD45 (Sc-53665, Santa Cruz Biotechnology, Dallas, TX), and F480 (123103, BioLegend, San Diego, CA), followed by detection with Florescent Dylight-555-conjugated secondary antibodies and counterstained with DAPI (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
